[[Alem's Remedy]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Alem the Unclean]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[The Sulfurous Wastes]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +15
:[[Dark damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Restoration Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Health]] +30
